definitions.explanation: An emergency procedure combining chest compressions and rescue breathing to maintain blood circulation and oxygen supply when someone's heart stops.

examples.japanese: CPR⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講習|こうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I took a CPR training course.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧CPR⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please continue CPR until the ambulance arrives.

notes:
CPR stands for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation. In Japanese, it is also called ⟦{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}→心肺蘇生：29912_shinpaisosei⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- CPR⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform CPR
- CPR{講習|こうしゅう}: CPR training
- CPR⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: CPR certification

JAPANESE TERMINOLOGY:
- ⟦{心肺|しんぱい}{蘇生|そせい}→心肺蘇生：29912_shinpaisosei⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧: cardiopulmonary resuscitation
- ⟦{胸骨|きょうこつ}→胸骨：18335_kyoukotsu⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧: chest compressions
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧: artificial respiration

EMERGENCY CONTEXT:
- Used together with AED (⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧{体外式|たいがいしき}{除細動器|じょさいどうき})
- ⟦{救命|きゅうめい}{講習|こうしゅう}→救命講習：29913_kyuumeikoushuu⟧: lifesaving course (offered by fire departments)
